Subject: Demo request from pricing page — Cartloom

Hi Mateo,

I was looking at the pricing page and filled out the demo request — Cartloom is evaluating an LLM inference provider for a payments fraud feature. We have strong budget intent and would like a short demo of the hosted + private deployment options.

Key context:
- Primary use: low-latency scoring for real-time fraud signals (100–200ms target)
- Expected volume: ~200k requests/day initially, ramp to ~1M
- Compliance: SOC2 required, possible on-prem later

Can someone from your team do a 30-min walkthrough next week? Prefer mornings PT. Also, please send any short agenda and pricing bands so we can align internally.

Thanks,
